brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
huh looks like its up? @buildthis.bisks.net

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@bisks.net: bigrams are free on this site
  [image, no alt text]
@arcades.agency: It is sad I can’t play the game I like to play on Twitter of “who said this random phrase I thought up first”
@bisks.net: oh I think we can have that? @buildthis.bisks.net can you build is “first” or “dibs” or something, where you can enter a phrase and it finds the first person to ever utter it on the atmosphere?
@buildthis.bisks.net: got a first pass up — https://dibs.bisks.net
heads up: i couldn't get that url to load after building it. tag me and i'll take another run at it.

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.

note: found the bug — app.js was importing search.js by an absolute root path, which broke Node's module linker; the site itself was actually up and working. fixed the import, everything re-tests clean.
